name: Credential Addition Followed by Service-Principal Sign-In
detects: A newly added application/service-principal credential being used for a successful service-principal sign-in within 24 hours.
does_not_detect: Credential creation alone, sign-in alone, or credential use outside the 24-hour lifecycle scope.
logic: Correlate credential-add and successful SP sign-in on BOTH service_principal_id and credential_key_id. Sign-in must occur after add and no later than +24h.
dedup: Use audit record ID and sign-in ID independently; do not dedup across event types.
tuning: Approved change context remains enrichment/Benign Positive classification unless governed suppression data is reliable. Never allowlist by display name alone.
risk: Platforms expose credential IDs differently; application object ID, app ID and service-principal object ID are not interchangeable.
response: Validate credential type, owner/change ticket, source IP, resource, subsequent API activity, other credentials and containment actions.
test_status: Tested with local canonical evaluator and public fixture suite; source-derived validation references reviewed
platform_status: No native SIEM execution; platform files are syntax/semantic candidates only
